style: Cartoon sound effect for a children's game, playful, clean studio quality, no music, no speech, no words.

burp.prompt: a short funny cartoon burp, bubbly and silly

burpBig.prompt: a long, loud, rumbling cartoon burp that wobbles and goes on and on, hilarious

toot.prompt: a short squeaky cartoon fart sound, silly and funny, kid friendly

tootLong.prompt: a long wobbly cartoon fart that rises in pitch like a rocket blasting off, hilarious, kid friendly

tootTiny.prompt: a tiny, polite, high pitched little cartoon toot, very short

chomp.prompt: cartoon character taking three big crunchy bites, chomp chomp chomp, munching

nibble.prompt: a cartoon bunny nibbling very fast, tiny quick crunchy bites

slurp.prompt: a long wet cartoon frog tongue slurp, then a big gulp

gulp.prompt: a single loud cartoon gulp, swallowing food

roar.prompt: a cute little cartoon lion cub doing its biggest roar, funny, not scary

purr.prompt: a happy cat purring loudly, then a short content meow

meow.prompt: a sneaky, mischievous cartoon cat meow

snore.prompt: a cartoon character snoring, a deep snore in and a whistle out, twice

monkey.prompt: an excited cartoon monkey calling 'ooh ooh aah aah'

bonk.prompt: a metal pot lid bonking a cartoon character on the head, clang, then a springy boing

whistleUp.prompt: a slide whistle going up very fast, cartoon

whistleDown.prompt: a slide whistle falling down, classic cartoon falling sound

alarm.prompt: a small cartoon smoke alarm beeping three times, funny, not harsh or loud

spit.prompt: a cartoon spit take, 'ptooey', blowing something out of the mouth

wahwah.prompt: a sad trombone playing 'wah wah wah waaah', comedic fail sound

scurry.prompt: tiny cartoon feet running very fast, pitter patter

peep.prompt: several cute baby chicks peeping and chirping

tiptoe.prompt: sneaky cartoon tiptoeing, plucked pizzicato strings, one note per step

wipe.prompt: a quick squeaky clean wipe on glass, one swipe

sneezeBig.prompt: a big funny cartoon sneeze, 'aaah... aaah... CHOO!'

zoom.prompt: a cartoon zoom whoosh as a character dashes away very fast
